Join us as a Team Lead Consultant and shape the digital transformation of healthcare across the DACH region. In this strategic role, you will lead complex healthcare software implementations, advise hospitals on optimizing clinical and administrative processes, and drive the successful implementation of innovative Hospital Information Systems (HIS). As a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and a mentor to your team, you will play a key role in delivering sustainable value for our clients while contributing to the growth of our consulting practice.

Lead system implementation, testing, and migration projects, including both Big Bang and phased rollout approaches.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with mid- and senior-level stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate interdisciplinary project teams and mentor consultants, fostering professional development and knowledge sharing.
Support business development by contributing to proposals, customer presentations, and workshops.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and digital transformation, delivering sustainable value for our customers.

University degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Health Informatics) or an equivalent qualification.
At least 7-10 years of professional experience in healthcare consulting, healthcare IT, or digital transformation projects within hospital environments.
Proven experience leading complex healthcare IT or digital transformation projects, ideally involving Hospital Information Systems.
Demonstrated experience leading project teams, coaching consultants, and managing customer relationships at management level.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to structure complex challenges and develop pragmatic, client-focused solutions.
Sound business acumen, including financial management, controlling, cost control, and quality assurance.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the confidence to engage senior decision-makers.
Collaborative leadership style, passion for mentoring others, and the ability to inspire high-performing teams.

Flexibility and willingness to travel throughout the DACH region as required.

Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.

Mobile work:  Work flexibly remotely two days a week and on site three days a week.

Work-Life Balance:  Take advantage of our job bike leasing offer, active break programs, and diverse online home workout videos to find the right balance and stay active alongside your work.

Corporate benefits:  Take advantage of attractive discounts for employees and benefits from various partners and providers.

jobs.employer_name: INM - Leibniz-Institut für Neue Materialien gGmbH
jobs.description:
Introduction

The INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials is an internationally leading center for interdisciplinary research on materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological engineering, physical analysis, process engineering and data science. We collaborate with academic and industrial partners all around the world.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
Very good communication skills in English.

Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
Transparent opportunities for career development.
Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
A family-friendly working place.
A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

jobs.description:
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place?
Then become a playmaker and join our team as Physical Security Specialist (f/m/d) at E.ON Digital Technology.
We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. We explore new paths by developing ideas, breaking new ground, making visions reality, and bringing new technologies to life. We deliver sustainable technology solutions because…
… it’s on us to make new energy work!

The Team – your impact
You are a member of the Crisis Management undamp; Physical Security Coordination team. Together with your colleagues you coordinate and continuously develop the physical security organization to protect our critical infrastructures, facilities, people and operating processes at E.ON.
Your Role – meaningful undamp; rewarding

- Support the development and continuous improvement of a group-wide, risk-based physical security framework, including policies, standards, and methodologies for asset protection
- Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of site security concepts across all business segments and locations
- Conduct and support risk and threat assessments (e.g., sabotage, vandalism, espionage, unauthorized access) and define mitigation measures
- Manage and support tendering and procurement of security services, ensuring quality and cost awareness
- Provide input on security requirements for new sites, buildings, and leases, including technical and personnel security solutions
- Contribute to the definition and standardization of on-site security operations (e.g., reception, gatekeeping) in collaboration with CREM
- Support the planning and coordination of executive and high-profile event security, including coordination of protection measures
- Contribute to executive protection activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
- Monitor, evaluate, and report security incidents, ensuring effective response and continuous improvement
- Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance security capabilities
Your Profile – authentic undamp; open-minded
- Several years of professional experience in Physical Security within a corporate or complex operational environment
- Expertise in physical security technologies and systems, frameworks, and relevant standards (e.g., ISO 27001)
- Good understanding of IT and OT environments, including grid/energy infrastructure, operations, and design
- Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to identifying and addressing issues
- Strategic mindset combined with strong business acumen and understanding of risk and value creation
- Confident working style with the ability to make sound decisions in dynamic situations
- Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and cross-functional approach
- Professional certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO is a plus
- Fluency in English and German (written and spoken)
- Valid driver’s license (Class B)
Our Benefits – smart undamp; useful​
- Recharge your battery: You have 30 days of paid vacation per year plus Christmas and New Year's Eve off. Your battery still needs charging? You can exchange parts of your salary for more paid vacation or you can take a sabbatical.​
- Advance your development: We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​
- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​
- Stay active undamp; healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​
- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​
- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​
- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

- Basic working knowledge of English
